A '''slicer''' was active during the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Corporate Espionage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the plans for a new [[Zentine Dynamics prototype shuttle|prototype shuttle]] from<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Zentine Dynamics]] and subsequently hid on the astronomical object [[Verroth]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the conflict between the Republic and the Sith Empire sent a companion to recover the data on Verroth. The latter individual [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into the slicer's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and destroyed his files, and also appropriated certain valuable items from a cache of tech data.<ref name="TOR" /> 
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The slicer was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' within the Crew Skill Mission "Corporate Espionage," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the video game.<ref name="TOR" />
